request.amount_ada: 500,000,000 ada net change limit; no direct withdrawal amount requested
request.deadline: Period begins at the start of Epoch 613 (February 13, 2026) and ends at the close of Epoch 713 (on or about July 3, 2027).
deliverables: Record DReps' agreement to a 500,000,000 ada cap on total Treasury Withdrawals debited during the period.
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period.
Apply the limit from the start of Epoch 613 through the close of Epoch 713.
request.what: Agree a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for Cardano Treasury Withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.
The proposed limit caps only the total lovelace removed from the Treasury by enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger during the period.
Treasury inflows, including reserve and protocol allocations, transaction-fee allocations, refunds, and returns of Treasury-funded amounts, do not count toward or increase the limit.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period count toward the 500,000,000 ada cumulative limit and remain valid.
The Info action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposal states that Yes votes exceeding 50% of active voting stake are sufficient to record DRep agreement to a Net Change Limit under TREASURY-01a.
The proposal says the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit has been useful but is becoming constrained through mid-2027.
The proposal asserts that the new 500,000,000 ada limit preserves room for DReps to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals while maintaining a fixed fiscal guardrail.
The proposal claims it is drafted to comply with Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and provides an IPFS reference to the enacted constitution.

summary: The document proposes an Info action to set a 500,000,000 ada Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713, with ledger-recorded Treasury Withdrawals counted cumulatively and no direct authorization of spending.
